purpose: Define how the reusable surface-grid stack will attach to the shared editor shell after P0 promotion without creating a second lifecycle, persistence path, or profile identity system.

controllerConstruction.compatibilityContextSource: active Island composition stability and override controls
controllerConstruction.profileChangeDestination: active editor envelope data map block

sharedLifecycleRules.event: surface model cell change erase move or resize
sharedLifecycleRules.action: write controller map into the active Island profile and call KaysenderEditorLifecycle.markDirty exactly once
sharedLifecycleRules.autosave: use the existing shared lifecycle recovery autosave delay and callback
the resulting model event performs the single dirty mark and autosave scheduling
do not mark the Island profile dirty until a brush changes a cell

sharedLifecycleRules.event: cell selection or keyboard focus movement
sharedLifecycleRules.autosave: do not mark the Island profile dirty

open: render the existing Island form and production panel
create the surface panel mount points
construct one IslandSurfaceGridController from the active profile
buildProfile: replace the profile map block with controller.getMap
derive map totals and downstream capacities
return one canonical Island domain profile
applyProfileToForm: apply non-map fields through the existing field mapping
call controller.replaceProfile with the imported migrated or recovered profile
preserve the nearest valid selected coordinate
validate: run the Island semantic reference validator
render all results through the shared diagnostics surface
newBlankRecord: clear the prior active envelope and recovery draft through the shared runtime
construct a blank Island profile with a default inactive grid envelope
replace the controller profile without retaining old linked IDs
recoverDraft: normalize and migrate the recovered envelope through the shared kernel
apply the recovered profile to the form and controller
preserve recovered stable cell IDs and references
importRecord: normalize and migrate the imported envelope through the shared kernel
reject future or unsupported schema versions
apply the imported profile to the form and controller
randomizeUnlocked: operate only on selected blank or explicitly targeted cells
skip brush field families whose target paths are locked
never regenerate the entire map because one field changed
exportCanonicalJson: flush controller.getMap into the active profile
export no view-only selected brush selected cell or active flag state
cloneRecord: clone the shared envelope identity through the existing kernel
retain nested cell and entity IDs inside the cloned domain record unless collision policy requires deterministic remapping
close: destroy the controller view toolbar and inspector subscriptions
retain the active envelope and recovery draft through existing runtime behavior

lockSemantics.rule: A field lock blocks only brushes or inspector controls that would change that field. A child field lock does not automatically block unrelated cell fields.

resizePolicy.removedRecords: returned by SurfaceGridModel.resize and retained in the current recovery state until save
resizePolicy.linkedEntityCheck: warn when a removed cell is referenced by water resources sites hazards landing zones habitats settlement slots or route nodes

activationGate: P0 integrated Island Settlement Airship browser receipt passes
P0 roadmap state is promoted to complete
surface-grid files are added to the Island adapter load path
surface-grid validator is added to the blocking workflow
valid and fractured fixtures pass live Chromium interaction tests
